event: 2014 Preseason Game 2, Jacksonville at Chicago, August 14, 2014
frozen: 2014-08-13, after the final walkthrough and Stone's reduction; before any draw
provenance: Stone's written plan of August 9 to 14, 2014 (career/2014/04_Training_Camp_and_Preseason/Preseason_Games/Game_02/Preseason Game 2_ HC.md), applied August 9 to 13 and reduced under its own rules (career/2014/04_Training_Camp_and_Preseason/Training_Camp/training_report.md#august-13-the-reduction-call-by-call). Every call is a retained call from the active 2013 offensive book (Iteration I) that the 2014 program has taught; nothing was installed new for this game. The correction mini-script order is carried in 'correction_opener' and the developmental opening 15 in 'developmental_opener' (the plan's numbering, with the gaps where a call came off); the kernel labels snaps uniformly from the sheet and does not condition on script order, exit rules or alerts, which remain in-game coaching guidance.

menus.correction_mini_script: the first group's eight calls in Stone's order (correction_opener 1 to 8): Power, Stick SCAT, Trey Drive HALF, Outside Zone, Boot Flood Right, Bunch Mesh HALF, Inside Zone + Bubble, Dagger HALF; the slow screen is on the first-group sheet but not an automatic early call
menus.developmental_opening_15: begins when Henne takes over; calls with a 'developmental_opener' index in that order; 10 (20 Flex F, Texas) and 15 (Four Verticals ALERT) are off the sheet, 7 is carried from 11 Doubles and 11 from the 11-personnel shift to Empty, each for the reason in the reduction table; situational calls override it
menus.third_down: third-and-short: Power, Counter, Inside Zone + Bubble (the access answer against a loaded box; Duo not active); third-and-medium: Mesh, Drive, Stick, Spacing; third-and-long: Dagger, Y-Cross, RB Slow Screen against justified pressure
menus.backed_up: Inside Zone, Power, Stick and the access throw if the leverage is free; the young group stays in
menus.red_zone: Power, Snag, Boot Flood (Smash off, not taught in the 2014 program); Mesh from Bunch carried from the spring red-zone work
menus.goal_line: Power, Counter, Power Pass only, the three run from that field location
menus.two_minute: Spacing (with and without the shift), Stick, Drive, Mesh, RB Slow Screen; the quarterback already on the field runs it
menus.four_minute: Inside Zone, Power, Counter and a safe complement from the normal-down sheet
menus.sudden_change: the next scheduled unit goes; the Outside Zone / Boot Flood pair from Wing, then the normal-down sheet
menus.HOLD_sequence: one sequence, Henne's twelve-personnel eleven, no substitution: 12 Ace Power, 12 Trey Drive HALF, 12 Wing Split Zone, 12 SHIFT toward Empty Stick, back to 12 Ace
menus.PRESS_sequence: one short sequence of mastered calls by signal and word: 11 Doubles Stick SCAT, 11 Doubles Spacing SCAT, 11 Doubles Inside Zone, 11 Bunch Mesh HALF; Cousins's group if his correction block lasts long enough and Henne's group; not Wilson, Bray or Shaw (a developmental quarterback earns PRESS in the preparation first, and the reserve group did not run it this week)
menus.reduced_menu_bray_shaw: Power, Counter, Inside Zone, Stick, Spacing, Mesh, Drive, Y-Cross, Boot Flood, RB Slow Screen, from the huddle (the plan's menu less the Four Verticals alert); Shaw runs the same core, his movement an answer when the play breaks down

units_rule: A call with no 'units' field is available to every group that takes a possession; a 'units' field restricts it. Protection defaults follow the book (quick game SCAT, five-man dropback HALF, heavy intermediate SOLID, boot NAKED) and are named only where Stone's plan names them.
notes: Cousins's exit rule (the second first down and the sequence after it, roughly 8 to 10 snaps, or two possessions, whichever first) is carried in rotation.json as two one-possession blocks with a 10-snap ceiling; the first-down rule is coaching guidance the kernel's schema does not carry.

Script order, the return to the opener on the next appropriate normal down, the possession ceilings and the plan's grading questions are coaching guidance the kernel does not condition on; they are recorded here and in rotation.json.

Off the sheet on August 13, each with its reason in the reduction table: 20 Flex F Texas; 20 Doubles Drive (carried from 11 Doubles); 10 Empty Spacing (carried from the 11-personnel shift); the Four Verticals alert; Slant-Flat; Draw; the RB slip screen; Smoke access; Smash; Duo; the ZIP H motion on the Trey Stick call. None has been taught in the 2014 program on the record; the active book holds every one of them.

Formation modifiers, direction and motion are descriptive fields; the kernel freezes them in the canonical sheet for audit and does not model motion response. Distinct directions of the same family from the same picture (Power Right and Left from Ace; Boot Flood Right and Left from Wing) are distinct calls on the plan and are frozen as such.
The plan's Trap, Wham, Jet, Scissors, flea flicker and 6OL exclusions are honoured by omission; the 6OL package has not been run in camp (Bradfield unsigned).

The defensive menu Crennel calls (Under and Nickel Even; Cover 1, 1 Robber/Rat, Cover 3, Quarters; base four and the installed five-man pressure) is sideline guidance recorded in rotation.json, not a kernel input.
